profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With over 15 years of software engineering experience, I specialize in building performant, scalable technology for high-growth companies. My technical expertise extends across the full stack, with deep experience in streaming infrastructure and large-scale distributed systems.
I bring a unique perspective to software engineering challenges, having worn multiple hats throughout my career - from co-founding startups to tackling complex legacy system modernization to developing machine learning algorithms for niche advertising solutions. This diverse background has honed my ability to approach problems creatively, whether building new products from the ground up or optimizing existing systems for scale.

Core Expertise:

Problem solving and technical solutions development
Streaming technology and media delivery infrastructure
Platform engineering and distributed systems architecture
Startup leadership and product development

I'm passionate about solving complex technical challenges that directly impact user experience and business outcomes. Always eager to collaborate with teams that are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with technology.
